subject: eng
title: Grammar 6A Ch 1: First Conditional & Nouns and Gender

questions.q: Sandy ___ fit if she ___ exercise every day.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.1：第一類條件句（First conditional），主句用將來式 will be，if 條件子句用簡單現在式 does。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Sandy ___ fit if she ___ exercise every day.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 1: First Conditional & Nouns and Gender

questions.q: If my brother Ken ___ any homework, he will visit Grandma on Sunday.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.1：if 子句中用簡單現在式，第三人稱單數 Ken 的否定式為 doesn't have。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: If my brother Ken ___ any homework, he will visit Grandma on Sunday.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 1: First Conditional & Nouns and Gender

questions.q: We ___ sashimi at the fish market if we ___ up early one day.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.2（Tim 的信）：主句用 will eat，if 子句用簡單現在式 wake。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: We ___ sashimi at the fish market if we ___ up early one day.

questions.q: In the play, Jerry is the king and Sarah is the ___.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.3（名詞性別）：king（國王）對應的女性名詞（feminine noun）是 queen（王后）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: In the play, Jerry is the king and Sarah is the ___.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 1: First Conditional & Nouns and Gender

questions.q: The ___ and the empress have a lot of gold and jewels.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.3–4：empress（女皇／皇后）對應的男性名詞（masculine noun）是 emperor（皇帝）。

questions.q: Which of the following is a 'common-gender noun' (can be used for both men and women)?
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.3：firefighter（消防員）、police officer、parent、child 等屬於通性名詞（common-gender nouns）。

questions.q: Fill in the feminine noun (Grammar 6A p.3): A man who acts in a film is an actor. A woman who acts in a film is an ___.
questions.explain: actor（男演員）對應的女性名詞是 actress（女演員）。

questions.q: Rearrange the words to form a first conditional sentence (Grammar 6A p.2).
items: Dad will take lots of photos
questions.explain: If 子句用簡單現在式（If the weather is fine），主句用將來式（Dad will take lots of photos.）。
answer: Dad will take lots of photos
